note: Rendered from the sealed S and X records. No question, gold call, or stored response.

function.name: play_sound_wave
function.description: Play a sound wave file. Unlike generate_sound_wave, which generates a sound wave file, this plays a sound wave file.

wave_file.description: The filename of the sound wave file to be played.

volume.description: The volume level at which the sound is to be played (1 is 100%). This is a float type value.

function.name: generate_sound_wave
function.description: Generate a sinusoidal sound wave file of a certain frequency for a specific duration and save it to a WAV file. Unlike play_sound_wave, which plays a sound wave file, this generates a sound wave file.

frequency.description: The frequency of the sound wave in Hz.

duration.description: The duration of the sound in seconds.

wave_type.description: The waveform to be used to generate the sound.
